title.en: Housing and Development (Change of Address) Rules

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. These Rules may be cited as the Housing and Development (Change of Address) Rules.

heading.en: Owners, tenants, authorised occupiers, etc., to notify Board of change of residential address

text.en:
2.—(1) This rule shall apply to —
(a)the owner, tenant or authorised occupier; and
(b)an applicant for the purchase or rental,
of any flat, house or building sold or let out by the Board pursuant to the Act.
(2) A person to whom this rule applies shall notify the Board in writing of any change of his residential address, except that where the person has made a report of the change under section 8 of the National Registration Act (Cap. 201), he shall be deemed to have notified the Board of the change of his residential address in compliance with this paragraph.
[G.N. No.S 399/96]
